Maya (Mktg Ops): Heads up — noticed ~40 leads this morning in HubSpot with owner set to `sticky-temp` after enrichment. They never entered the round-robin pool. Anyone else seeing an ownership bounce?
Alex (RevOps): Yep I see the same. Queryed HS logs, looks like enrichment webhook returned before assignment hook fired. timing window ~2s.
Sam C (Growth): Oof. That would explain the stale handoffs for web form leads. Are those leads missing the `assigned_by` field?
Alex (RevOps): Some are. Sample row: `lead_id=LD-2389 owner=sticky-temp assigned_at=null enrichment_status=complete`
Maya (Mktg Ops): We're pretty strict about SLA: assigned within 30s, otherwise fallback to overflow. This slipped through because our fallback only triggers on `owner=null` not `owner=sticky-*`.
Priya (AE): From a seller perspective it's bad: leads show an owner but it's a placeholder and they don't get notifications. We're losing contact windows. Can we patch fallback to treat `sticky-*` same as null?
Marcos (Sales): +1. Also want a quick offset so any `sticky-*` older than 60s goes to RR.
hubspot-sync-bot: Sync job completed 2026-03-21T08:14:02Z. Processed 12,412 leads. 0 errors. Avg webhook latency: 1.9s.
Alex (RevOps): Short-term patch: change fallback rule to `owner IS NULL OR owner LIKE 'sticky-%'` and add a 60s TTL check. I can deploy rule change in HubSpot tonight.
Sam C (Growth): Can we avoid treating newly-injected sticky owners as immediately eligible for sales assignment? Maybe set `owner_temp` field instead of `owner` until assignment confirmed?
Maya (Mktg Ops): Good idea. Longer term we should update enrichment worker to write `owner_temp` and then have a single assignment microservice promote to `owner` after confirmation. That prevents race.
Priya (AE): For tonight, can we also send an alert to #sales when we auto-reassign from sticky to real owner so reps know?
Alex (RevOps): Yep — I'll add a one-off that posts a brief digest to #sales for reassigned leads and push an automation to set `owner` properly. Will coordinate with Sam on infra changes.
Marcos (Sales): Thank you. Also pls include the lead creation time in the digest so reps can prioritize older ones.
Maya (Mktg Ops): Action items: 1) Alex to patch HubSpot fallback rule (ETA: 18:00 PT). 2) Sam + Alex to design `owner_temp` flow (design doc tomorrow). 3) Priya to draft sales digest copy. 4) Marcos to confirm notification cadence. I'll follow up after patch. :thumbsup:
Alex (RevOps): Patch queued. I'll post deploy-bot message when live.
Maya (Mktg Ops): Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
deploy-bot: Fallback-rule patch started by Alex (RevOps) — run id 20260321-rrfix.
Alex (RevOps): Patch completed. Monitoring for reassignments now. If anyone sees anomalies, ping me directly.
Maya (Mktg Ops): Seeing reassigns flowing through already — good catch team.
Priya (AE): Noted — prepping digest template.
Sam C (Growth): I'll open the design PR for `owner_temp` today.
Marcos (Sales): All good from my side. Thanks.
